Bidaya (بداية, Arabic for "beginning") is a management and tech consultancy based in the UAE. It acts as the executive layer for funded startups and established SMEs that don't have one yet: CEO, CFO and COO scope across company setup, operations, finance and tech, run inside the business by one firm, engaged monthly or for fixed-scope projects. Published terms: monthly engagements from AED 12,000; the first month carries no notice; every engagement can end on thirty days' notice; unpaid discovery ends at the thirty-minute call; when a business doesn't need a monthly engagement Bidaya says so in writing. Programs are partnership structures co-delivered with cultural and educational institutions for creative businesses and practitioners.
